tellings.quote: For example, General Neil McCasslin's case seems eerily possibly connected to Monica Resza's.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, made an episode about American scientists who he says have gone missing, and in it he looks at the case of a retired Air Force general named Neil McCasland and the case of a woman named Monica Reza. Michels says the two cases seem "eerily possibly connected," though he doesn't say how. If he's right, it would point to a pattern behind the disappearances rather than unrelated events.
